::: {.home-presentation}
Hi, I am Matteo!\

I am a first-year PhD student at the [Center for Mind and Brain Sciences (CIMeC), University of Trento](https://www.cimec.unitn.it/en).\
Previously, I got an Advanced MSc in AI from KULeuven and a MA in Linguistics (computational) from University of Pavia.\
To know more about my background, check my [CV](https://drive.google.com/file/d/REPLACE_WITH_CV_FILE_ID/view).

My doctoral research focuses on language acquisition in machines and humans, the
learning dynamics of language models, and the alignment between artificial
neural circuits and human neural activation.\
To do so, I combine methods from machine learning, neural network interpretability, linguistics and cognitive neurosciences.

Feel free to contact me to discuss any related topic.

## Here you can find

- [Research](research/): papers, preprints and news about my work.
- [Bites & Thoughts](writing/): short posts about ideas (_thoughts_) or stories (_bites_) that I find worth sharing. [IN PROGRESS]{.section-status}
- [My Bookshelf](bookshelf/): an attempt to record all the books I have read and different sources of inspiration. [IN PROGRESS]{.section-status}
:::
